title: 会前预读材料怎样写，才能让大家带着想法来
topic: 会前预读材料怎样写，才能让大家带着想法来

source.title: Prepare for Meetings with a Pre-read - Dropbox
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Dropbox 公开资料。
paragraphs: Lessons learned in write for understanding and write with brevity apply here. Pre-reads should achieve one goal: provide enough information to someone who may have little to no context so that they can meaningfully contribute in the meeting. Your pre-read should take the place of the common “Let me bring folks up to speed…” part of the meeting, saving five to ten minutes upfront. Attendees should be able to grasp the basics in five minutes or less. Try to format your pre-read in bullets to force clarity. Bonus points if you’re able to link out to meaningful components where folks can optionally learn more in advance (example: a Dropbox folder, a collaborative document like Paper document, or a ticket in a project management system).

An effective way to train those who routinely attend meetings you organize is to maintain a single source of truth. By putting your pre-read materials in the shared agenda document that’s already attached to your meeting invite, you’re conditioning attendees to refer to the agenda before, during, and after meetings. It’s a good idea to share the pre-read one to two business days in advance. If all else fails, allocate time for silent reads to begin your meeting. When sharing, remind folks what they’re expected to read, why they’re expected to read it, and that you’re linking the same agenda doc that’s already in the meeting invite.

As you share the pre-read, ask folks to provide feedback if something is ambiguous or confusing. This not only helps you craft future pre-reads to be more concise and focused on the right things, but it also serves as a subtle nudge for attendees to actually read the pre-read. This tiny step adds a layer of accountability and touches on the power of reciprocity. Attendees will recognize that you’re going above and beyond by providing a pre-read and asking for feedback, which in turn makes them more likely to reciprocate by reading (and hopefully, sharing a bit of input).
translations: 在写作时追求理解与简洁的经验教训同样适用于此。预读材料应实现一个目标：为那些可能缺乏背景信息的人提供足够的信息，以便他们能在会议中有意义地做出贡献。你的预读材料应取代会议中常见的'让我向大家同步一下...'环节，从而节省五到十分钟的会议时间。与会者应在五分钟或更短时间内掌握基本内容。尽量使用项目符号格式来组织你的预读材料，以增强清晰度。如果你能够链接到有意义的组件（例如：一个Dropbox文件夹、像Paper这样的协作文档，或项目管理系统中的一个工单），那就更好了。
培训那些经常参加你组织的会议的一种有效方法是维护单一事实来源。通过将预读材料放入已附在会议邀请中的共享议程文档中，你正在引导与会者在会前、会中和会后都参考这份议程。提前一到两个工作日分享预读材料是个好主意。如果其他方法都失败了，则为会议开始留出默读时间。分享时，提醒大家需要阅读的内容、阅读的原因，以及你链接的是会议邀请中已有的同一份议程文档。
当你分享预读材料时，请要求大家对任何模糊或令人困惑的内容提供反馈。这不仅有助于你撰写更简洁、更聚焦于重点内容的未来预读材料，同时也作为一种温和的提醒，促使与会者实际阅读预读材料。这一小步骤增加了一层责任感，并触及了互惠的力量。与会者会认识到，你通过提供预读材料并征求反馈，已经付出了额外的努力，这反过来使他们更可能通过阅读（并希望提供一些意见）来回报你。

notes.phrase: Lessons learned in write for understanding and write with brevity apply here
notes.meaning: 理解性写作和简洁性写作的经验教训在此适用
notes.explain: 这句话强调了两种写作技巧在准备会前预读材料时的重要性：确保内容易于理解，同时保持简洁
notes.example: Lessons learned in clear communication and active listening apply here when preparing for client presentations.

notes.phrase: maintain a single source of truth
notes.explain: 指在团队中建立并维护一个权威、一致的信息来源，避免信息混乱或版本不一致
notes.example: Our team maintains a single source of truth by using a shared project management dashboard.

notes.explain: 指一种温和但有效的方式，鼓励或提醒人们做某事，而不显得过于强制
notes.example: The reminder email serves as a subtle nudge for attendees to submit their reports before the deadline.

notes.explain: 指人们倾向于回报他人给予的好处或善意，这是一种社会心理学原理
notes.example: In negotiations, offering a small concession can leverage the power of reciprocity to get what you want.

scenario.title: Shortening a pre-read without losing the point
english: A colleague says the pre-read for an upcoming meeting is too long to review.
The purpose is to give participants a short summary they can read in about five minutes and invite them to flag unclear points.
You offer to condense the material into concise bullets and ask what still needs clarification.
chinese: 同事说，下一次会议的预读材料太长，读起来费时间。
你希望把材料压缩成五分钟左右能看完的要点，并让参会者指出不清楚的地方。
你提出精简材料，并请对方标出仍需说明的内容。

firstAttempt.prompt: 一份方案预读包含两个上线选项、客服风险数据和几个待决定的问题。请用英文告诉参会者要先看什么、阅读时要比较什么，并请他们在周三中午前留言。
firstAttempt.sample: Please review the two rollout options before the meeting. As you read, consider which option creates less support risk. Please add comments by Wednesday noon.
firstAttempt.rationale: 预读要求应告诉大家看什么、重点考虑什么，以及何时留下意见。

words.collocation: prepare pre-reads, distribute pre-reads, comprehensive pre-reads
words.example: I’ll send a five-minute pre-read with the key points and questions.
words.translation: 我会发一份五分钟可读的预读材料，列出重点和问题。
words.note: 在商务环境中，pre-reads特指会议前分发供参与者阅读的材料，有助于提高会议效率。

words.collocation: value brevity, appreciate brevity, known for brevity
words.example: Brevity helps participants review the pre-read before the meeting.
words.translation: 简洁的预读材料更方便参会者提前阅读。
words.note: brevity强调用最少的文字表达最多的意思，是高效沟通的重要原则。

words.collocation: provide context, lack context, in context
words.example: Keep the context that readers need to understand the decision.
words.translation: 保留读者理解这项决定所需的背景。
words.note: 在商务沟通中，提供适当的context是确保信息被正确理解的关键。

words.collocation: behavior conditioning, positive conditioning, conditioning process
words.example: A short, consistent pre-read can condition participants to look for the decision first.
words.translation: 简短、稳定的预读格式能让参会者逐渐养成先看决定事项的习惯。
words.note: 指通过重复经历逐步形成某种反应或习惯。

words.meaning: 模棱两可的，含糊不清的
words.collocation: ambiguous statement, ambiguous instructions, feel ambiguous
words.example: Replace ambiguous points with a short explanation or question.
words.translation: 用简短说明或问题替换含糊的内容。
words.note: 在商务沟通中，ambiguous的表达容易引起误解，应尽量避免。

words.collocation: reciprocate kindness, reciprocate efforts, willing to reciprocate
words.example: If a colleague reviews your pre-read, you can reciprocate by reviewing theirs.
words.translation: 如果同事帮你看预读材料，你也可以帮对方看一遍。
words.note: 表示回应或回报对方的行为、帮助或好意。

structure.original: Pre-reads should achieve one goal: provide enough information to someone who may have little to no context so that they can meaningfully contribute in the meeting.
analysis: "Pre-reads should achieve one goal" 是主句，使用情态动词"should"表达建议或期望，"one goal"作为表语
"provide enough information to someone" 是冒号后的同位语，解释"one goal"的具体内容，其中"to someone"是介词短语作状语
"who may have little to no context" 是定语从句修饰"someone"，其中"may have"表示可能性，"little to no"是固定搭配表示"几乎没有"
"so that they can meaningfully contribute in the meeting" 是结果状语从句，表示目的，其中"meaningfully"是副词修饰动词"contribute"
structure.transfer: A five-minute pre-read can include the decision to make, a short summary, and the questions participants should review.

rewrite.bad: Please read every background document before the meeting, even if it takes an hour.
rewrite.good: Please review the two rollout options before the meeting. As you read, consider which option creates less support risk. Please add comments by Wednesday noon.
rewrite.translation: 请在会议前查看两种上线方案。阅读时，比较哪一种带来的客服风险更低。请在周三中午前在文档中留言。
rewrite.pattern: Please review [the options] before [the meeting]. As you read, consider [the key question]. Please add comments by [deadline].

cloze.prompt: Please ___ the two rollout options before the meeting.
cloze.why: 明确预读范围，避免材料过多或遗漏重点。

cloze.prompt: As you read, consider ___ option creates less support risk.
cloze.why: 给出思考问题，帮助读者带着判断进入讨论。
设定反馈时间，确保会上能讨论已有意见。

dictation.text: Sarah needs to prepare pre-reading materials for the quarterly budget review meeting with department heads.
Her manager insists on comprehensive details while colleagues prefer concise summaries due to time constraints.

translationPractice.prompt: 请在会前查看两种上线方案。
translationPractice.answer: Please review the two rollout options before the meeting.

translationPractice.prompt: 阅读时请考虑哪种方案带来的客服风险更低。
translationPractice.answer: As you read, consider which option creates less support risk.

choice.prompt: 会前材料包含两个上线选项和客服风险数据。请选出能告诉参会者看什么、比较什么，并要求周三中午前留言的预读请求。
options: Please read the rollout proposal before the meeting and add comments whenever you have time.
Please review the two rollout options and the support-risk data. As you read, compare which option is likely to create less support risk, and add your comments by Wednesday noon.
The pre-read is too long, so I’ll shorten it to five minutes and send it later.
choice.why: 明确材料、阅读时要考虑的取舍和留言期限，参会者才能带着意见进入讨论。

output.prompt: 下周要决定是否把新功能先开放给 5% 的用户。请用英文写一段会前预读要求，告诉大家先看哪些材料、比较什么风险，并在何时留下意见。
output.sample: Please review the rollout proposal and incident data before the meeting. As you read, compare the risks of a 5% rollout with a wider release. Add your comments by Friday noon so we can focus the discussion on open questions.
check: 是否说明会前需要看哪些材料？
是否提出阅读时需要考虑的问题？
是否给出留言截止时间？

credits.audio: 美式英语合成朗读，非公司员工原声。
